description: This file defines a Java interface 'KafkaSpecificConfig' in the org.eclipse.ditto.services.connectivity.messaging.kafka package. It specifies methods for checking applicability, validation, and configuration application for Kafka connection settings within the Ditto project, facilitating flexible Kafka configuration management.

classes.name: KafkaSpecificConfig
classes.description: An interface for managing Kafka configuration logic, including applicability checks, validation, and applying configuration to producer properties.

methods.name: isApplicable
methods.description: Checks if the Kafka configuration is applicable to a given connection.

methods.name: validateOrThrow
methods.description: Validates the connection against the Kafka configuration and throws an exception if invalid.

methods.name: isValid
methods.description: Checks if the connection configuration contains valid values for Kafka.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Applies Kafka configuration to the provided producer properties if applicable and valid.
